label: fix 1: plan
result:
I've fixed all 16 skeptic failures in `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/spec/v2-upgrades/plan.md`. Nothing from an earlier fixer had been saved, so every fix is new. The file is not committed, as the task said.

What changed:
- **Classes removed (decision 5):**
  - The `assigned` task and all Homework text are gone from L4, L10, L12 and the overrides.
  - The classes calls are gone from §2.9, and the assignment rule is gone from the T2 row.
  - A "No classes" bullet sits at the top. Scorecard row 41 is now "Not built".
  - The file had no Compete class groups to replace.
- **Keyed by subject (decision 3):** points, coverage, score, projection, verdict and pace are all keyed by subject. Plan settings live under `sections` (a Math part and an optional R&W part), with the old top-level Math fields still accepted. Focus caps and domain checks are per subject.
- **New L21, the R&W half of the plan:**
  - R&W current and target sliders, R&W time chips, and the 4 R&W domains with Focus/Normal/Strong.
  - Craft and Structure and Expression of Ideas on Focus change the Words run.
  - A typed R&W task for each focus domain, and a new `rw_log` table fed by the Bluebook sheet (L11) and the R&W tasks.
  - The Total shows in the title, the Score tile, drift and the Plans rows.
  - An R&W section in the DomainCard, and a fourth BankStats tile for Words.
- **Visible actions and nothing collapsed:**
  - Skip, Mark done, Again and Undo are buttons on every row, and every task has a real checkbox. The ⋯ menu keeps Move, Swap, Make it a section, Edit and Remove.
  - Why lines always show. The changelog lines stay open.
  - SkillRows and the 19-skill table are open, and every plan is listed (paged by 20 only past 20 rows).
  - On phones the Live plan sits inline above the footer on every step.
- **Daily budget (L4 and L9):** one fill rule now covers own tasks, the test, Words, every question kind and focus. It has fixed targets and minimums, and each cut kind has a stated place to go.
  - On a day under 35 minutes the test moves to another day.
  - A self-check covers every minutes chip × pace from 60 to 150 seconds × Words on/off × phase: no day ever runs over its minutes.
  - L9's acceptance checks are rewritten for a 95-second pace with Words on.
- **Allocation (L1, L2):** the value-per-minute formula is fixed, with a floor weight and an assert that a +20 skill always outranks a mastered one.
  - A new `pins` field replaces `tiers_by_topic`: pins are 2-question segments inside a focus set, at most 1 a day and 30% of slots, ordered by points.
  - The every-skill coverage window scales with slots per week, and cells that can't be planned are shown as "not planned before Final". Checks run on a 15-min × 2-day plan and a 45-day new-student plan.
  - Gate mode now clearly wins over hard pins.
- **Verdicts that don't flip on noise:**
  - A focus check passes only with 3/4 plus 9 of the last 12 right.
  - The test-out is 8 questions needing 7 right.
  - Auto-promoted skills get 2 keep-warm questions a week.
  - A checkpoint is judged on its ±70 band: beat, within the band, or under. The ✓ appears only on beat.
- **Step 2 TargetNote:** the "N of 44 right" count is dropped (recorded under Rejected). The note shows the points share and the named skills.
- **L6 live question:** the preview returns a question and a signed token. Answering it creates a one-question `plan_preview` session. A new student sees their real day 1: the diagnostic, then Map days.
- **L8 Start today:** Words is the last block of the run. Its finish reply returns the plan's next step. Own tasks show on the rail as "on your own" and as checkboxes on the receipt.
- **L14 checkpoints:** two baselines alternate. Each slot is marked when its question type was practised since the baseline. "Fix these" serves other question types of the same skill and tier, and a caveat line says some of the gain is familiarity.
- **L15 changelog:** a new `plan_events` table records every edit and automatic change. The daily snapshot is also taken from Today, and the header reads "Since Tue" when it has been a few days.
- **L18 Not moving:** defined as two windows of 20 answers each, flagged when the gain is under 10 points.
- **L19 last weeks:** rehearsals replace Final's weekly tests, and no test lands on a taper day. The "last timed set" is 10 questions that fit the 27 minutes. v2's acceptance 2 and its self-check are rewritten to match.
- **Scorecard, overrides, Rejected:** scorecard rows 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 15, 16, 18, 21, 22, 24, 25, 26, 33, 36, 41 and 42 are updated, and row 43 (both sections) is new. §3.1 and §3.2 now match the changes above.
